description: Defines data types, constants, and functions related to PDCCH candidate list generation and CCE calculation for 5G NR (3GPP TS38.213) in the ocudu namespace.

methods.name: max_nof_monitored_pdcch_candidates
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of monitored PDCCH candidates per slot for a given subcarrier spacing.

methods.name: pdcch_candidates_common_ss_get_lowest_cce
methods.description: Generates a list of lowest CCE indices for common search space candidates based on configuration.

methods.name: pdcch_candidates_ue_ss_get_lowest_cce
methods.description: Generates a list of lowest CCE indices for UE-specific search space candidates based on configuration.
